statement: For the actual fixed arithmetic h of D46, the closed normal closure C_h of f_h gives exactly the maximal marked quotient H_h on which h acts pointwise as identity. Its full relative-prime source is the coherent inverse limit over every finite h-fixed marked base refining D48, with both kernel inclusions proved. The arithmetic-two/identity-odd peripheral automorphism on this source projects to the entire D48 action and parameter. The exact common quotient with D48 is H_h/R_nil(M-plus/C_h), and the projection kernel is an exact extension of this full residual group by the stated product of primewise kernels; its nonsolvable A5 quotient is retained. The entire global-sign congruence quotient factors through the identity-three component, because the full congruence image of C_h lies in the exact principal three-congruence kernel. No unproved full3-adic vanishing for the original h is used. The new source is strictly larger. Its remaining kernel has exact image W=[V,A] in the actual mixed homology quotient over G3, with dimension |G3|/6*(1-1/|A|); it contains the actual cyclic moving subspace of determined dimension64*3^97. The integral central augmentation map is onto, proving [L,Bhat]=L and complete stabilization of the earlier central-cover route.
